items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: if Johnny wouldn't make a job, I'd work with that band, you see.

ctx.x: Johnny Bebe. Abbey for Johnny. Oh, yeah.
How come the Johnny wasn't on the record?

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Chani Bebe was the drummer, you see, but he was a crack drummer. But they wanted me to play on the con and they figured Chani might get high or something

ctx.x: That was the Young Morgan Band. Well, they called it Sam Morgan Band. Sam Morgan Band. Sam Morgan Band. But, say, Sammy got the best go year. You know, Johnny Day, I picked him right now, standing on Seminole in Claiborne waiting to catch the North Claiborne called the Ride Up Canal Street. Yeah. Well, that same year you're speaking about was John Morrell had got several fellas out there in the tuxedo band to make that record. I see. And he had wanted, Chani Bebe was the drummer, you see, but he was a crack…
So Paul Barch wasn't doing that band anymore then? Who? Paul Barch was gone. Oh no, no. He was up in New York that time.
